title: ALMA observations of the Extended Green Object G19.01-0.03 - II. A massive protostar with typical chemical abundances surrounded by four low-mass pre-stellar core candidates
question: What are the physical and chemical properties of the massive protostar G19.01-0.03 MM1 (hot core chemistry, CH3OH temperature structure) and its protocluster environment (four neighbouring millimetre sources), given ALMA 1.05 mm and VLA 1.21 cm data?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.25 mJy/beam; wide-spw line cubes ~3 mJy/beam in emission-free channels; narrow-spw cubes ~6 mJy/beam per 0.5 km/s channel

recipe.goal: Extract continuum sources and measure their properties
recipe.method: astrodendro dendrogram on the self-calibrated 1.05 mm continuum image

recipe.goal: Identify molecular lines in the wide spws
recipe.method: Match emission peaks to JPL/CDMS rest frequencies at the systemic velocity and confirm with LTE synthetic spectra
key_parameters: typical hot core model parameters, T > 100 K, used for the identification spectra
assumptions: Lines at the source systemic velocity of MM1

recipe.goal: Rotation diagram of CH3OH at the MM1 continuum peak
recipe.method: LTE rotation diagram, with and without opacity correction, of eleven CH3OH transitions
key_parameters: A and E transitions fit together
assumptions: LTE and optically thin emission, single temperature

recipe.goal: Bayesian LTE fit of CH3OH at the continuum peak and pixel by pixel across MM1
recipe.method: emcee MCMC over WEEDS/CLASS LTE synthetic spectra of six CH3OH lines in the ~278 GHz band, repeated per pixel within the MM1 continuum source size
key_parameters: Uniform priors: N 0.05-3.0e18 cm-2, T 80-300 K, v_cen 56.0-64.0 km/s, dV 2.0-8.0 km/s
source size fixed to the geometric mean of the ~278 GHz synthesised beam (~0.5''); ALMA projected diameter 558 m
assumptions: LTE with background continuum included; all modelled transitions arise in the same emitting region (outflow-tracing 9(-1,9)-8(0,8) and 6(1,5)-5(1,4), blended lines and the vt=1 line excluded)
Background continuum from the ALMA 1.05 mm continuum converted to brightness temperature

recipe.goal: Column densities and fractional abundances of other species
recipe.method: Order-of-magnitude LTE fits with only column density free, per species, then ratios to CH3OH and H2 column densities
key_parameters: T = 162.7 K, v = 59.7 km/s, dV = 6.4 km/s fixed from the CH3OH fit; source size ~0.5''
assumptions: Line emission of MM1 species has the same extent as the continuum

recipe.goal: Derive the 12C/13C ratio from CH3OH isotopologues
recipe.method: Ratio of 12CH3OH to 13CH3OH column densities at the MM1 peak
assumptions: Optically thin lines, same rotational temperature, similar spatial extent

recipe.goal: Gas masses and densities of MM1...MM5 from dust emission
recipe.method: Isothermal optically-thin-corrected dust mass from integrated 1.05 mm flux density
key_parameters: MM1 T_dust = 163 K; MM2-MM5 T_dust = 15 and 24 K
assumptions: spherical geometry, mu_H2 = 2.8, radius = half the geometric mean of source sizes; D = 4 kpc

recipe.goal: Compare source number and masses with thermal Jeans fragmentation
recipe.method: Thermal Jeans mass and radius from clump properties, N_Jeans = M_clump x CFE / M_J
key_parameters: Hi-GAL and ATLASGAL clump properties; CFE 13%

recipe.goal: Virial analysis of MM4 using DCN
recipe.method: Virial parameter from DCN(4-3) hyperfine-fitted velocity dispersion and dust mass
key_parameters: sigma_obs = 0.58 +/- 0.03 km/s (mean across FWHM size of MM4); radius ~2000 AU
assumptions: flat density profile (n = 0), T_dust equal to gas temperature, DCN mu = 28

recipe.goal: Characterise NH3(3,3) and 25 GHz CH3OH maser candidates in the VLA data
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian (point-source, beam-sized) fits to >=5 sigma emission spots; compare angular separations of NH3(3,3) and 44 GHz CH3OH masers with K-S and A-D tests
key_parameters: >=5 sigma emission in >=2 consecutive channels, spatially contiguous within a beam; sigma measured per channel
25 GHz CH3OH: 4 sigma criterion; thermal if >=5 channels, maser candidate if <=4 channels
assumptions: Emission expected to be unresolved, fitted size fixed to the synthesised beam
